about: SHA-256 of every file of the rule database, with line endings normalised to LF. negsim refuses to load a file that is not listed here or whose contents no longer match. A file is frozen once it is listed: a changed rule is a new file with the next version number, never an edit, and the old version stays.

schema/rule.v2.schema.json.note: The rule format, schema version 2 (issue #30): source_type 'stated', intent, screening, and the generation and promotion records of provenance. Version 1 files are read against version 1.

schema/rule.v3.schema.json.note: The rule format, schema version 3 (issue #32): the directive field back_up, true or false as a comparison's value, and the four passage fields in the catalogue. Version 1 and 2 files are read against their own.

rules/keep_right_head_on.v1.yaml.note: Seed rule, test_seed, not in the default set (issue #28, Part 6).

rules/passage_shorter_backs_out.v1.yaml.note: Seed rule, test_seed, not in the default set (issue #32, Part 2.5).

rules/younger_yields_head_on.v1.yaml.note: Seed rule, test_seed: the example rule of issue #28, Part 2.

rulesets/default.yaml.note: The rule set switched on by `ruleset: default` (issue #28).
